evidence.name: NetCommPlayerSlotSync

function_ir.summary: Multiplayer player-slot synchronization. Gated on the SyncInProgress byte at this+0x374 (non-zero returns early). Pass 1 walks active player slots from base this+244 (dword index, byte offset this+0x3D0, stride 140) while ActiveSlotCount at this+0x3E14 is positive, FlagBitTest(slot-60, 2) marks occupied slots, and occupied slots with a non-empty name run join processing: per-vehicle slot derived from the vehicle array at &unk_5EC6D8 + 18624*slot, driver-name comparison via PathFilenameExtractor/sub_588410, resource load (VehgenScnFileLoader, SceneRenderUpdate, force-feedback, cockpit gauges, physics subsystem), joined-slot message display and sound flags. Pass 2 walks the whole vehicle array up to byte_7C54D8, unloads slots that vanished (not marked in pass 1), displays a leave message, trims the session-path linked list (this+0x3FC8 head / this+0x3FCC tail / this+0x3FD0 iterator / this+0x3FD4 count) to remove the departed path, resets the vehicle to inactive, and repoints the current player. VehicleCount at dword_5C329C is adjusted, ClearPlayerSlots runs, and the active vehicle pointer array is rebuilt.

local_names.this: network/session manager (slot list, path list, session mode)
local_names.v1: copy of this (stable across slot-pointer arithmetic)
local_names.v4: per-slot entry pointer starting at this+0x3D0 (244 as a dword index), advanced by 140
local_names.v33: working slot pointer (this+0x3D0 base reused after advance)
local_names.v5: vehicle slot index (v4[64]) and stride factor 18624
local_names.v14: vehicle-array walk pointer for pass 2, stride 18624
local_names.v37: count of slots still present (processed in pass 1)
local_names.v40: 104-byte per-slot presence bitmap (byte per slot index)
local_names.v25: linked-list node being unlinked from the path list

operations.description: Re-entry guard: byte at this+0x374 non-zero returns immediately, skipping the entire sync pass
Local state init: 104-byte presence buffer v40 memset to 0 and locals i, v30, v32, v37, v35 cleared to 0
Join-detection loop gated on ActiveSlotCount at this+0x3E14 being greater than 0 (packet guard)
Pass 1 walks player slots from base this+0x3D0 (244 as a dword index) stepping by 140 bytes, bounded by ActiveSlotCount at this+0x3E14
Per-slot occupancy test via FlagBitTest(slot-60, 2); only occupied slots with a non-empty name (strlen check) are processed for join
Slot index v5 = v4[64]; vehicle slot pointer derived as &unk_5EC6D8 + 18624*v5; inactive slot check reads *(slot+3250) == -1

PathFilenameExtractor on the vehicle slot then sub_588410 string comparison against the slot name; join path entered when names differ, or the vehicle pointer at *(slot+1780) is null, or the slot is inactive
TwoCallDelegation(v6, v4) delegates vehicle setup calls, then StringCopyWithBufferRealloc copies the slot name into the driver field at slot+1920

Re-check with sub_588410 and the vehicle pointer; when still mismatched the join setup runs: sub_45C030 on the slot-scoped UI data, ThunkWithStructInitSubCalls, and PerElementArrayReset(this+26864, v5)

Player-vs-AI branch: when v5 equals IDLookupInArray(*this), the slot is the local player — SessionStateTransition((float*)v6+3, 0, 0) if the slot data flag at *(slot+16484) is clear or the slot is inactive, then SetPlayerVehicleIndex_bc40(v5); otherwise SessionStateTransition((float*)v6+3, 2, 0)
Slot metadata update: ConditionalFieldSetter(slot+16436, v5+1) and FieldCopy(slot+16436), tied by the skeleton to the slot-array field at this+0x410

Server-only 'LOADING slot' log: when dword_7C569C != 5 and StringSplitLoop(dword_8AD25C, 1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4014) succeeds, DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, aLoadingSlotInd-style '*** LOADING Slot' line with slot index and session time dbl_8AFEA0)
Vehicle load completion: increment VehicleCount dword_5C329C, BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray, VehgenScnFileLoader(v6, 1), SceneRenderUpdate(v6, 1.0), LoopOverTwoParallelArrays(dword_8ACEE0)
Active-slot post-load path: when *(slot+3250) is non-zero, join flags v31/v30 are set and ShortComputation_5430(*(slot+4645), slot+65 byte) runs, tied by the skeleton to the slot byte at this+0x411

Inactive-slot path: 'slot is tagged as' debug log (aSlotIsTaggedAs), loop over dword_7C54F0[v10] entries (v10 < dword_5C329C) calling AudioSoundEffectController(entry+1776, 0), then SetPlayerVehicleIndex(v5), GameStateBranchDispatch(dword_5EA510), CockpitDashboardLEDGaugeSetup(dword_7CE058), PhysicsSubsystemStep(dword_7C73E8, v5)
Per-slot data copy: sub_587DD0(slot+18016, name-24, 0x17), clear byte at slot+18039, and if strcmp(slot+17952, name-56) differs call SetDriverName(slot, name-56)

Joined-slot message: when join flag v31 is set, BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aHasEnteredTheG, byte_5EC4CC) copies the 'has entered the game' text, StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v41, "%s %s", slot+17952, byte_5EC4CC) formats it, and TextLineWrappingAndRendering(dword_7CD204, v41, 3, 16909060) displays it
Presence record: v40[v39] = 1 marks the slot as still present, and the slot pointer advances by 140
Pass 2 walks the whole vehicle array from &unk_5EC6D8 by stride 18624 while below the byte_7C54D8 end; entries not marked in v40 and still active (*(slot+3250) != -1) are treated as departed players

Leave message: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aLeftTheGame, byte_5EC4CC) copies the 'left the game' text, StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v41, "%s %s", slot+17952, byte_5EC4CC) formats it, and TextLineWrappingAndRendering(dword_7CD204, v41, 3, 16909060) displays it

Server-only 'UNLOADING slot' log: when dword_7C569C != 5 and StringSplitLoop(dword_8AD25C, 1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4111) succeeds, DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, aUnloadingSlotI-style '*** UNLOADING Slot' line with index and session time dbl_8AFEA0)
Path-trim block gated on SessionMode at this+0x3FC4 being 2 (qualifying) or 1 (race); a backslash scan on the session path at slot+18196 trims the trailing filename segment

Session-path linked-list removal: iterator at this+0x3FD0 seeded from head this+0x3FC8; nodes are walked comparing the node string at offset 0 (*(this+0x3FCC):0) against the trimmed path via sub_588410, following the next pointer at offset 4 (*(this+0x3FCC):4); on match the node is unlinked, head this+0x3FC8 / tail this+0x3FCC / count this+0x3FD4 are updated, and the node is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the flag byte at offset 8 (*(this+0x3FCC):8) is set
After unload: sub_4C6E80(v14) cleans the vehicle slot, then SessionStateTransition((float*)v14+3, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0) marks the slot inactive

Current-player repoint: when the departed slot was the current player (dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC]+18580 match) and the candidate at dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4]+18580 is inactive (dword_5EF9A0[4656*v27] == -1), scan dword_7C54F0 for the first active slot (+13000 != -1) and set dword_7C54DC and dword_7C54E0; otherwise SetPlayerVehicleIndex(v27)

Server-only 'Unsetting slot' log: when dword_7C569C != 5 and StringSplitLoop(dword_8AD25C, 1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4164) succeeds, DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, aUnsettingSlotI-style '*** Unsetting Slot' line with index)
Post-removal cleanup: when removals occurred (v34 > 0), ClearPlayerSlots(v1, 1), decrement VehicleCount dword_5C329C by v34, and BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray
Sound effects: when SessionMode at this+0x3FC4 != 1 (packet guard), SoundEffectLoadPlay(0/1/2, 1065353216) fires for join/enter/leave flags i, v30, v32 respectively
When the processed-slot count v37 differs from VehicleCount dword_5C329C, dword_5C329C is updated to v37 and BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray's result is returned; otherwise the sync returns v37
Invoked by SessionScoringUpdate (004643c0)

clean_pseudocode: DebugLogWrite(dword_8AD25C, "*** LOADING Slot...", idx, slot, dbl_8AFEA0);
for (veh = &unk_5EC6D8, n = 0; veh < byte_7C54D8; veh += 18624, n++) {
trim trailing filename from veh + 18196 path;
walk path list from this[4082]; if found, unlink node, update head/tail/count, free via FreeWrapper_7bcf;
if (current player left) repoint dword_7C54DC / dword_7C54E0 to next active slot;
if (v37 != dword_5C329C) { dword_5C329C = v37; return BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray(); }
unresolved: String globals aSS_2 (0x005C5D30), unk_5EC6D0 (0x005EC6D0), dword_7CD2A8 (0x007CD2A8) and byte_8AC494 (0x008AC494) are flagged by packet facts but appear nowhere in the raw decompiled source; the skeleton labels them as driver-settings suffix, vehicle-array base, a menu struct and a scene name, all unverifiable from this packet

Several vehicle-slot offsets reached through the &unk_5EC6D8 + 18624*slot base (e.g. +1780, +3250, +16436, +4645, +17952, +18016) are read/written but not enumerated as packet fields; only the linked-list node fields (this+0x3FCC base) are packet-flagged
The exact semantics of GameStateBranchDispatch / SessionStateTransition arguments (0, 2, 0xFFFFFFFF) are call-level states, not defined by this packet

seed_provenance.seed_note: Focused caller/callee closure for the four highest-leverage blocked SDK interfaces: main tick, vehicle physics step, session transition, and network send. Recover owner/thread/lifecycle/dependency evidence; candidate evidence only.

uncertainty_rules: RAW decompiler source outranks translated prose and proposed names.
Same offset or same this pointer does not prove shared ownership.
Unresolved ABI, owner, lifecycle, and cut-edge questions remain explicit.
VALID means evidence-grounded and schema-valid, not runtime-confirmed.
